description: This file defines the interface 'ConfigurationConsumer' in the package 'com.rusefi'. It declares methods for handling the start and end of a configuration file, as well as processing configuration structures.

classes.name: ConfigurationConsumer
classes.description: An interface for consuming configuration events during processing of configuration files.

methods.name: startFile
methods.description: Method to indicate the start of a configuration file processing.

methods.name: endFile
methods.description: Method to indicate the end of a configuration file processing.

methods.name: handleEndStruct
methods.description: Method to handle the end of a configuration structure, receiving the structure as a parameter.
